capture.sequence: one uncaptured cold energy-plus-force execution followed by one captured warm execution

methodology_notes: Both engines use the exact 96-AO batch-1 acceptance workload and the acceptance SCF and screening tolerances.
The VIBEQC profile was captured from the tree published as clean commit 93f6eee; the unchanged GPU4PySCF values come from the matching clean 1.8.1 capture published with c28b1e9.
VIBEQC's runtime capture span is the interval from cuProfilerStart through the final captured CUDA synchronization, derived from the exported Nsight Systems trace.
Component values sum CUDA kernel durations by demangled kernel family; they do not include CPU work or idle gaps.

The direct-J/K category contains the direct quartet kernels; its small density-bound, compaction, and spherical-transform helpers are included in other. GPU4PySCF direct J/K includes Rys K, MD J, density-transform, and q-condition kernels.
The GPU4PySCF fallback force kernel covers total angular orders six through eight for this s/p/d def2-SVP workload.
Span-minus-summed-kernel is diagnostic only because concurrent kernels, if present, make duration sums non-additive.
